name: status-full-tier-without-opt-in-header-403
description: GET /status?detail=full WITHOUT the Coherence-Local-Operator opt-in header returns 403, even when the bearer passed. The header keeps the operator view from being fetched by accident; it is an opt-in, not authentication. Both backends.
_comment: The two backends word the refusal differently, so the row asserts the status code and that an error is present, not its text.
